title: Add bulk download and device sync
context: Download or sync many repositories to a device, detecting what is missing or stale before copying.

spec.summary: Add bulk download and device sync
spec.expected_outcome: Confirm the migrated scope and acceptance criteria.
acceptance_criteria: Missing, stale, and extra entries are reported.
A `.sync-state.json` records the last synced commit per repository.
The command exits non-zero when the device is not in the desired state.
Docs cover a second device with a different state.
